description: A Notion database with one row per work item. The Status and Stage columns are select (or status) properties; every value in status_map must exist as an option in the database.
fetch: With the Notion connector, fetch the database at meta.tracker.target and query every row (follow pagination). Write a JSON list to a file with one object per row, keyed by this adapter's field names: Name (title), Status, Stage, Updated, Link; flatten every property to a plain string (a select or status as its option name, a date as ISO text, empty as an empty string), and save the rows as the tracker holds them: never build the list from the plan.
relational_fetch: With the connector, query every row of each database the plan's meta.tracker.target names (one for epics, stories, tasks and releases, or one shared database; all pages). Save ONE JSON list; add "kind": "epic" | "story" | "task" | "release" to each row by the database it came from; flatten a relation to the related rows' titles joined by ", "; every other property to a plain string as in fetch. Never build the list from the plan.
